arStrings.szText: Blocking increases the damage of {c_important}Crushing Hand{/c} by {c_number}[{SF_40}*100|%x|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_43}{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}[{SF_41}*100|%x|]{/c}.

{c_important}Crushing Hand{/c} grants a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[{SF_11}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_11]){/c} for {c_number}{buffduration:BARRIER}{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}[{SF_13} * 100|%|]{/c} {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_13]){/c}.
{c_important}Crushing Hand{/c} costs {c_number}[{SF_36} * 100|%|]{/c} more Vigor but deals {c_number}[{SF_37} * 100|%x|]{/c} more damage.
Every {c_number}3rd{/c} {c_important}Crushing Hand{/c} smashes {c_number}{SF_16}{/c} additional times dealing {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_A}{/c} damage each.
{c_important}Crushing Hand{/c} smashes a single time in a smaller area in front of you, dealing {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_B}{/c} damage and {c_number}[{SF_34}*100|%|]{/c} of your Thorns.

{c_important}Crushing Hand{/c} becomes a {c_important}Centipede{/c} Skill that deals Poison damage. 

{c_important}Crushing Hand{/c} sends centipedes scuttling across the ground, Poisoning enemies for {c_number}{dot:DOT}{/c} damage over {c_number}[{buffduration:DOT}]{/c} seconds. Enemies Poisoned from {c_important}Crushing Hand{/c} are {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c}.
